identity_policy: Study-defined SPO-2 rigid polyurethane formulation based on synthesized suberinic-acid/tall-oil-derived polyols. The Table 9 inputs are 67 g SA-C_TOFA(50:50)/TMP and 33 g SA-E_ETOFA(50:50)/TMP, unlike the existing LPO-1 Lupranol 3300/3422 formulation. This is one selected representative of the SP formulation series, not all suberin-derived polyurethane foams. SPO-2 is a study label, not a certified grade. Do not count SPO-1/SPO-3, LPO-2/LPO-3, cure times, specimens or translations as extra identities in this packet. No final molecular formula, purity, elemental composition or universal material equivalence is inferred.
